description: Primary-sourced carbon fiber filament properties, unidirectional CFRP composite micromechanics parameters (Vf = 0.60 in structural epoxy matrix), and reference structural alloys.

matrix_reference.name: Aerospace toughened epoxy resin (typical)
matrix_reference.note: Unidirectional axial modulus computed by longitudinal rule of mixtures E1 = Vf * Ef + (1 - Vf) * Em; composite density rho_c = Vf * rho_f + (1 - Vf) * rho_m.
matrix_reference.compressive_allowables_note: Each fiber row's sigma_kink_comp_Vf60_MPa is a representative UD (Vf=0.60 in epoxy) compressive kink-band engineering assumption (NOT a primary filament-datasheet lower bound), included in this SHA-256-pinned data file so all compressive envelope calculations are cryptographically bound.
